# oneuptime_io_t_device_credential (Resource)

Io t device credential resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_io_t_device_credential" "example" {
  iot_fleet_id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
  external_id = "Example short text"
}
```

## Schema

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource. Computed.
- `project_id` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Computed.
- `iot_fleet_id` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Required.
- `external_id` (String) The device id — must match the device.id label the device stamps on its datapoints. It is also the <device> segment of the device's MQTT topics, so a device that reports directly over MQTT cannot use an id containing '/', '+', or '#' (such devices can still report through a gateway).. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Create IoT Device Credential], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Read IoT Device Credential, Read IoT Fleet], Update: [No access - you don't have permission for this operation]. Required.
- `name` (String) Any friendly name of this device. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Create IoT Device Credential], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Read IoT Device Credential, Read IoT Fleet], Update: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Edit IoT Device Credential]. Computed.
- `is_enabled` (Bool) Disabled credentials are rejected at MQTT CONNECT and stop the device's silent-death offline detection.. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Create IoT Device Credential], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Read IoT Device Credential, Read IoT Fleet], Update: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Edit IoT Device Credential]. Computed.
- `created_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `updated_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `deleted_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `version` (Number) Object version. Computed.
- `last_connected_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Computed.
- `secret_key` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Computed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import oneuptime_io_t_device_credential.example <id>
```
